note: Metadata only. This file records where each upstream corpus lives and what may be fetched automatically. It contains no upstream data and must never contain any: the whole point of shipping an anchor registry instead of a dataset is that the licences travel with the data, not with us. URLs are transcribed verbatim from the upstream download helpers (RCAEval/utility/__init__.py) rather than composed, so a typo here cannot invent a source that does not exist.

notFetchable.reason: The telemetry is published on Google Drive, not on an HTTPS endpoint with a stable contract. Drive adds interactive confirmation, per-account quotas and rate limiting, which makes it unfit for a deterministic CI gate. Reaching it through the AgentiX-E/openrca-* shard repositories was the plan, and that plan does not work: their caches were populated on 2026-08-02 and had expired by the time this was checked, and a GitHub Actions cache is scoped to the repository that wrote it, so a shard's cache would not be readable from here even while it existed. The shards remain the right place to do the download; they are not a source this repository can read.
notFetchable.alternative: Re-run AgentiX-E/openrca-{telecom,bank,market}-{dates-early,dates-late,cloudbed-1,cloudbed-2} .github/workflows/cache-dataset.yml, then have that repository publish the derived artifact rather than caching it

notFetchable.reason: PAVE-style step-wise causal-path annotations are not published as a bulk downloadable archive.
